title: sales.order.update_line
description: Changes the quantity of a line of an open order — and, through it, whether it is a gift (is_gift/gift_reason), its note (notes) — and recomputes the check's provisional total (ADR-0141). The discount of a line does NOT go through here any more (sales#385): it goes through the capped doors `sales.order.set_line_discount` / `sales.order.set_line_discount_over_limit`, which price the line on the server. This schema refuses a payload that still carries `discount_percent`, so a stale caller fails loudly instead of writing a discount with no cap.
